subject.title: Text between tool calls leaks to messaging channels

question: Should external messaging source replies keep automatic bare-text delivery by default, or should channel-visible output require an explicit final phase or message(action=send) boundary?
rationale: Current main intentionally preserves automatic delivery defaults while the issue asks for explicit-send semantics; that tradeoff affects existing users, security expectations, cron delivery, and channel UX.

options.title: Adopt explicit external-channel boundary
options.body: Make external channel delivery require explicit user-visible final/message-tool output, with focused upgrade proof and documented compatibility behavior.

options.title: Keep automatic defaults with opt-in mitigations
options.body: Land narrow opt-in or verbose-gated fixes while preserving existing bare-text delivery defaults for compatibility.

options.title: Split immediate mitigations from default policy
options.body: Land non-breaking suppressions first and keep the default automatic-vs-explicit decision open as a separate product item.

recommendation.title: Adopt explicit external-channel boundary
recommendation.body: Make external channel delivery require explicit user-visible final/message-tool output, with focused upgrade proof and documented compatibility behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The central blocker is the delivery default and compatibility policy, and steipete authored the recent automatic-default policy commit.
